$comment: Light declarative input for the generated forms. It may only (1) rename (labels, encounterTypes, units), (2) bind CIEL concepts (concepts, values), (3) say how the host supplies values a person should not retype: objects it looks up (existing), stable facts that carry over as an editable prefill (carryOver), the role that records events (roles), and explicit object-reference choices (references), and (4) add a field with a written reason (extra). Every other field and rule comes from the Nexo document and catalog.

$labelDecisions.$comment: Display names that an agent chose for the care pathway and the forms where the protocol's own words are authoring text. The protocol is unchanged. Each entry names a label above and gives its reason, who decided (agent or Kuang) and its status (review pending or accepted), as in forms.layout.json.

second reading, exact observation chrono.reason: I#390: the second-reading task names its missing information in authoring words, and the history and task card showed them as is. The label uses the terms of the form that collects it: the blood-pressure reading, the time that the form records with it, and the visit findings.

title:lifestyle_counselling.reason: The protocol title "Lifestyle modification advice (RBCNCD24 PDF p.25); the source names no cadre" carries a citation and an authoring note. The label is the wording proposed to I#324 (docs/o3-walkthrough.md). It renames the form too, so Initializer gives the form a new UUID.

dash_diet.reason: Lifestyle advice item. RBCNCD24 PDF p.25 reads "DASH diet" (Dietary Approaches to Stop Hypertension); the generated name read "Dash diet". The wording proposed to I#324.

physical_activity_150_min_week.reason: Lifestyle advice item. The generated name read "Physical activity 150 min week". RBCNCD24 PDF p.25 reads "Moderate-to-vigorous activity 150 min/week", and the label keeps that intensity so that it gives the same advice as the source. Care check: the label states the advice of RBCNCD24 PDF p.25, so the direction of care does not change. The wording proposed to I#324.

glycaemia.reason: Laboratory test in the health centre work-up. RBCNCD24 PDF p.25 reads "glycemia"; the generated name read "Glycaemia". The wording proposed to I#324. I#324 Part 2 B is to confirm the local clinician term.

hba1c.reason: Laboratory test in the health centre work-up. RBCNCD24 PDF p.25 reads "HbA1c"; the generated name read "Hba1c". The wording proposed to I#324. I#324 Part 2 B is to confirm the local clinician term.
